title: Bertoni 2024 preprint · Awake and overnight chest PPS
citation: Bertoni et al. (2024). Multisensory integration in Peripersonal Space indexes consciousness states in sleep and disorders of consciousness. bioRxiv v1.
notes: Preprint study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.geometry: Fixed sound positions 30 and 130 cm above the chest. Each sound lasts 100 ms and each tactile stimulus 5 ms. The preprint does not specify paired onset offset.
published_method.interview: Verbal interphone report of dream experience, experience without recall, or no experience, with branch-dependent sensory ratings and alertness.
published_method.analysis: Compare centroparietal high-beta near-minus-far multisensory contrast across wake and sleep stages and reported mental states.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Three wakefulness blocks. Trials fully randomized within each block.

iti_jitter_policy.source: bioRxiv v1 pp. 4 and 18, Fig. 1 and Protocol – awake session

response_window.source: bioRxiv v1 pp. 4 and 18, Fig. 1 and Protocol – awake session

task_sequence_rules.value: Lie in bed with eyes closed, receive stimulation passively while EEG is recorded. No active per-trial response.
task_sequence_rules.source: bioRxiv v1 pp. 4 and 18, Fig. 1 and Protocol – awake session

value.calibration: Subjective match to selected PPS sound

tactile_stimulus.source: bioRxiv v1 pp. 4 and 17–18, Fig. 1 and Stimuli
tactile_stimulus.gap: Pulse shape and ambiguous adjustment direction are described for calibration. Acquisition waveform, trigger and electrode geometry unresolved.

soa_table.source: bioRxiv v1 pp. 4 and 17–18, Fig. 1 and Stimuli
soa_table.gap: The preprint labels paired rows ANT and AFT but gives no numeric or explicit healthy onset alignment. The journal STAR Methods p. e2 explicitly states synchronized onsets.

baseline_strategy.value: Tactile-only and auditory near/far trials serve as unimodal controls. EEG and spectral analyses use prestimulus reference measurements.
baseline_strategy.source: bioRxiv v1 pp. 19 and 21–24, healthy EEG, spectral and statistical methods

value.baseline: prestimulus mean for EEG; mean baseline PSD across all five conditions

baseline_timing.source: bioRxiv v1 pp. 19 and 21–24, healthy EEG, spectral and statistical methods
baseline_timing.gap: The source does not give a distinct range for the EEG baseline window within the prestimulus epoch.

catch_trial_type.value: No response-inhibition condition among five passive EEG stimulus families.

implementation_gaps: Requires synchronized EEG and polysomnography, fixed-speaker routing, calibrated chest stimulation, closed-loop stage detection and overnight interphone interviews.
Healthy preprint paired offset, exact set of ITI levels and overnight per-trial schedule are unresolved. Journal-version settings are separate.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
